data_fields.name: gate_poll_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 2323 to 8234 ms, varies per gate (e.g. 2500 at line 39, 8234 at line 240)

best_idea: Quest steps are parked waits on game time that re-poll a state gate and then add a short completion pause, so a quest is a list of gates the server tick advances deterministically.
decision_why: Keep the parked, game-time gate shape and the completion pause, but as declarative zone data run by the server tick rather than Lua coroutines in scenario files; Lua code in data files conflicts with zones as data.
acceptance: A fake-clock test shows a step gate is not checked before its wake time, the objective is marked done only after the pause, and the step advances exactly once when the third ship exists.
